engineering_gate.derivation: E55 thresholds 0.5 median / 1.0 max divided by sqrt(4), because E56 judges Monte-Carlo noise of the four-replica MEAN rather than one replicate

methodological_clarification: Independent without-replacement subset draws are independent conditional on the fixed eligible random pool even when realized subsets overlap. Replica averaging estimates conditional subset Monte-Carlo noise, not common finite-pool discretization bias.

primary_variance_decomposition.between_mock_SD: sample SD of nine four-replica mock means
primary_variance_decomposition.mock_mean: mean of four calibrated Fminus-Fplus coordinates within each mock

scope.galaxies: same all source-eligible full mock galaxies
scope.reuse: mock0001 R1-R4 from E54; all other R1/R2 and DD from E55
